types.name: Visa exemption (short-term stay)
types.purpose: Tourism, business meetings or visiting relatives without a visa — for visa-exempt nationalities.
types.note: Usually up to 90 days per stay (15 or 30 days for some nationalities). No paid work.

types.name: Temporary Visitor visa (short-term stay)
types.purpose: Tourism, business meetings, conferences or visiting relatives, for nationalities that need a visa.
types.maxValidity: Single entry 3 months; multiple-entry up to 5 years for some nationalities
types.note: The period of stay (15, 30 or 90 days) is set when you land and stamped in your passport.

types.name: JAPAN eVISA (short-term stay)
types.purpose: Online single-entry short-term visa for residents of eligible countries.
types.maxValidity: 3 months, single entry

types.name: Visa for Medical Stay
types.purpose: Medical treatment in Japan, and accompanying persons.
types.maxValidity: Up to 3 years (multiple entry)
types.note: Each stay up to 90 days, or 6 months to 1 year when hospitalisation is needed.

types.name: Working Holiday
types.purpose: Holiday with short-term work for young people (usually 18–30) from partner countries.
types.maxValidity: Up to 1 year

types.name: Highly Skilled Professional (incl. J-Skip)
types.purpose: Highly skilled researchers, engineers and business managers scoring enough points, or meeting J-Skip income/education thresholds.
types.maxValidity: 5 years (type i); unlimited (type ii)

types.name: Professor
types.purpose: Research or teaching at a Japanese university.
types.maxValidity: Up to 5 years (granted as 3 months, 1, 3 or 5 years), renewable

types.name: Artist
types.purpose: Artistic activities that bring income (composers, painters, writers…).
types.maxValidity: Up to 5 years (granted as 3 months, 1, 3 or 5 years), renewable

types.name: Religious activities
types.purpose: Missionary or religious work sent by a foreign religious organisation.
types.maxValidity: Up to 5 years (granted as 3 months, 1, 3 or 5 years), renewable

types.name: Journalist
types.purpose: Reporting for a foreign news organisation.
types.maxValidity: Up to 5 years (granted as 3 months, 1, 3 or 5 years), renewable

types.name: Business manager
types.purpose: Starting, running or managing a business in Japan.
types.maxValidity: Up to 5 years (granted as 3 months, 1, 3 or 5 years), renewable

types.name: Legal / Accounting services
types.purpose: Lawyers, accountants and other licensed legal or accounting professionals.
types.maxValidity: Up to 5 years (granted as 3 months, 1, 3 or 5 years), renewable

types.name: Medical services
types.purpose: Doctors, dentists, nurses and other licensed medical professionals.
types.maxValidity: Up to 5 years (granted as 3 months, 1, 3 or 5 years), renewable

types.name: Researcher
types.purpose: Research under a contract with a public or private organisation in Japan.
types.maxValidity: Up to 5 years (granted as 3 months, 1, 3 or 5 years), renewable

types.name: Instructor
types.purpose: Language or other teaching at elementary, junior high or high schools.
types.maxValidity: Up to 5 years (granted as 3 months, 1, 3 or 5 years), renewable

types.name: Engineer / Specialist in Humanities / International Services
types.purpose: Engineers, IT, interpreters, designers, marketing and other office professionals.
types.maxValidity: Up to 5 years (granted as 3 months, 1, 3 or 5 years), renewable

types.name: Nursing care
types.purpose: Certified care workers working in nursing care.
types.maxValidity: Up to 5 years (granted as 3 months, 1, 3 or 5 years), renewable

types.name: Intra-company transferee
types.purpose: Transfer to a Japanese office of your employer.
types.maxValidity: Up to 5 years (granted as 3 months, 1, 3 or 5 years), renewable

types.name: Entertainer
types.purpose: Performing in theatre, music, sports or entertainment.
types.maxValidity: Up to 3 years

types.name: Skilled labor
types.purpose: Work needing special skills: chefs of foreign cuisine, sports trainers, pilots, sommeliers…
types.maxValidity: Up to 5 years (granted as 3 months, 1, 3 or 5 years), renewable

types.name: Specified Skilled Worker (i) / (ii)
types.purpose: Work in sectors with labour shortages (care, construction, food service, manufacturing, agriculture…) after skills and Japanese tests.
types.maxValidity: (i) up to 5 years in total; (ii) renewable without limit, family can join

types.name: Technical intern training
types.purpose: On-the-job technical intern training programmes (being replaced by Employment for Skill Development).
types.maxValidity: Up to 1–2 years per stage, at most 5 years

types.name: Cultural activities
types.purpose: Unpaid study of Japanese culture or arts, such as tea ceremony or martial arts.
types.maxValidity: Up to 3 years

types.name: Student
types.purpose: Study at a university, college, high school or Japanese language school.
types.maxValidity: Up to 4 years 3 months

types.name: Training
types.purpose: Learning skills at a public or private organisation (not technical intern training).
types.maxValidity: Up to 1 year

types.name: Dependent (family stay)
types.purpose: Spouse or children of a foreign resident working or studying in Japan.
types.maxValidity: Up to 5 years

types.name: Spouse or child of Japanese national
types.purpose: Spouse, or biological or specially adopted child, of a Japanese national.
types.maxValidity: Up to 5 years

types.name: Spouse or child of permanent resident
types.purpose: Spouse or child born in Japan of a permanent resident.
types.maxValidity: Up to 5 years

types.name: Long-term resident
types.purpose: People of Japanese descent and others granted residence for special reasons.
types.maxValidity: Up to 5 years or as designated

types.name: Designated activities (incl. digital nomads)
types.purpose: Activities designated individually: e.g. digital nomads (up to 6 months), job-seeking graduates, interns, domestic workers of diplomats.
types.maxValidity: Up to 5 years or as designated
types.note: The digital-nomad stay is limited to 6 months.

types.name: Diplomat
types.purpose: Diplomatic missions and their families.
types.maxValidity: For the duration of the mission

types.name: Official
types.purpose: Officials of foreign governments or international organisations on official duty.
types.maxValidity: Up to 5 years

types.name: Permanent resident
types.purpose: Living in Japan permanently, usually after 10 years of residence (shorter for highly skilled professionals and spouses).
types.maxValidity: Permanent
types.note: No day count. Leave with a re-entry permit, or the status can lapse.
